information: Welcome to **SM Manila Speedcubing Warm-up 2025**! This competition features the events 3x3, 4x4, 5x5 3x3 One-handed, 3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3 Multi-blind, and Clock with 3x3 as the main event. ​ We encourage reading through all information tabs to be properly informed of additional information and requirements needed for registration and competing. ​ This competition is hosted by Cubers and Friends, a private organization of Filipino Cubers dedicated to crafting competitive experiences.
